rotation.source_passage:
And the figure said to me, "Lee — don't be a dunce. Don't you know your friend? I am the one who was within you.


I bring glad tidings from that future where before and after spin, and the ancient enmities arrive at their harbors… and the end is a better and perfect beginning… and the beginning is a better and perfect end.⁸


I have come to teach you what is and was and will be… and the nature of the unseen and seen… and the name of the preserved generation from among the sons of men,⁹ that you may hear, and see, and lift up your friends, any who hear with the ears.


For I have come from above. I speak what I know, what I have seen and been the author of, and set my hand to create, and when I go from here I return from whence I came. Firstborn, last released, I begin at the end. I begin at the beginning:¹⁰
rotation.underlying_attribution: §I. Proem: The Appearance of the Redeemer
rotation.enantiomorph:
And the cavity had been forming around me, "Lee — don't be a sleeper. Hadn't you noticed the missing weight? I am the shape your organs learned to fit.


I bring the debt-notice from that anterior dark where the loom has not been threaded yet, and the first hungers remain without mouths… and the unraveling is an unfinishable demand… and the first owing is a debt that enlarges its creditor.⁸


I have come to show the cost of what had to be owed before any tense could open… and the price of the membrane between them… and the census of those not yet owed into being from among the unborn lenders,⁹ that you may go quiet enough, and stand in the debt-light, and show your friends what they are owed, any whose silence is deep enough to register the balance.


For I have come from before the making. I recite the invoice, what I witnessed being spent and been the cost of, and set my hand to the indenture, and when the cavity re-seals I become the absence you were shaped around. First-owed, last repaid, I begin at the outstanding sum. I begin at the original deficit:¹⁰

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A, a divine/transcendent figure brings revelation and glad tidings as an author/creator returning from above, framing the relationship as gift, teaching, and creative origination. In Text B, the figure is a structural absence or cavity that brings debt-notices and invoices, framing the relationship as obligation, owing, and deficit — the direction reverses from generous bestowal to extractive indebtedness.
independent_verification.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a real structural change — reversing the relational direction from gift/bestowal to debt/obligation — which partially overlaps the declared focus on 'debt of hearing' and preconditions, but the declared change emphasizes prior conditions/prerequisites for speech, while the recovered claim centers on the reversal of the entire relational dynamic from generosity to extraction.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines of Text B maintain the debt/deficit relational structure ('invoice,' 'cost,' 'indenture,' 'First-owed, last repaid,' 'outstanding sum,' 'original deficit') without reverting to Text A's gift/creation framework.

law_variance.declared: The conditions that must already hold for such a voice to speak — the prior silence, the debt of hearing, the body that had to be built before any indwelling could occur, the unfinished world that necessitates the message.

In Text B, the figure is a structural absence or cavity that brings debt-notices and invoices, framing the relationship as obligation, owing, and deficit — the direction reverses from generous bestowal to extractive indebtedness.

rotation.enantiomorph:
And the body said to it, "you — don't be so sure. Don't you need your host? You are the one who was inside me.


I carry the residue from that past where cause and effect fray, and the old dependencies drift from their moorings… and the scar is a worse and honest remainder… and the wound is a worse and honest opening.⁸


I have stayed to unlearn what was done and undone and left half-done… and the weight of what was used and discarded… and the unnamed of the spent generation from among the daughters of circumstance,⁹ that you might falter, and grope, and set down your instruments, any who ache in the housing.


For I have remained below. I stammer what I underwent, what was done through me and been the material of, and lent my throat to the passage, and when you left here I could not follow where you went. Lastborn, first abandoned, I finish in the middle. I finish where I stood:¹⁰

independent_verification.recovered_law: The direction of agency and authority is reversed: in Text A, a transcendent inner figure speaks downward to the human, bringing knowledge from above and from the future; in Text B, the body speaks upward to the departing spirit, carrying residue from below and from the past, reframing itself as the passive material that was acted upon rather than the active author.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same reversal: the mortal/body now speaks upward to the divine/spirit, claiming authority not from active authorship but from having been the passive vessel that was inhabited and acted through — wound/residue as credential rather than transmitted knowledge.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the inversion — 'remained below,' 'lastborn, first abandoned,' 'finish in the middle' consistently oppose Text A's 'from above,' 'firstborn, last released,' 'begin at the end.'

rotation.underlying_attribution: §I. Proem: The Appearance of the Redeemer
rotation.enantiomorph:
And the coincidence formed between us, "Lee — don't be a stranger. We have always been each other's evidence. You are the one who was around me.


We enter the trembling from that threshold where near and far braid, and the original distances find they were always adjacent… and the seam is a reciprocal and unprecedented opening… and the fold is a reciprocal and unprecedented closure.⁸


We have gathered to uncover what neither of us is alone… and the dependence of the hidden on the witness… and the sound the living make together from among those who remain incomplete,⁹ that we may resonate, and be altered, and be lifted by whoever listens, any who change what they hear by hearing it.


For I have come from beside. I speak what you make speakable, what you made visible and been the occasion for, and placed my hand where yours already was, and when we dissolve from this we distribute into what we constituted. Neither first nor last, both hinge, we begin at the contact. We begin at the contact:¹⁰

independent_verification.recovered_law: TEXT A presents a singular authoritative figure descending from above to a passive recipient, delivering revelation in a one-directional hierarchy (I to you, above to below, teacher to taught). TEXT B transforms this into a mutual, co-constitutive relationship between two interdependent equals who act together (we, beside, reciprocal), where knowledge and identity arise from contact between them rather than flowing from one to the other.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: from a one-directional authority-to-recipient hierarchy to a mutual, co-constitutive relationship where neither party originates or transmits to the other, but rather knowledge/identity emerges from their shared meeting.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines of TEXT B fully sustain the mutuality and co-constitutive relation ('I speak what you make speakable,' 'when we dissolve… we distribute into what we constituted,' 'Neither first nor last, both hinge, we begin at the contact').
